what: The plan makes no-retry handling for Codex setup failures optional even though the new rc==1 retry loop would otherwise retry them
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed rc==1 transient retry would turn a deterministic _prepare_codex_home failure into 3 attempts by default, violating the stated fast-fail constraint and the existing one-shot regression coverage in python/test_agents.py:1095-1119
suggested_fix: Make the no-retry path mandatory for _prepare_codex_home failures, for example with an internal sentinel rc handled by the loop as fail-without-retry, and keep the existing setup-failure test asserting one probe call
